env.description: Values are only included in the app detail, for callers allowed to read secrets.

oneOf.description:
Whether the app can be reached through the gateway, apart from
whether it runs (null while it has no route).

paused.description: Why delivery is paused, while it is: new runs wait.

AppEvent.description: A Kubernetes event about one of the app's objects.

kind.description:
Kind and name of the object (`Pod`, `Deployment`, `HTTPRoute`,
`Certificate`, …).

gate.description: `pass`, `warn` or `block`: what the environment's gate says now.

canDecide.description: Whether the caller may decide on this run now.

expiresAt.description: When the run is cancelled unless approved (Unix milliseconds).

planHash.description: What an approver confirms: send it back with the decision.

requestedBy.description: Email of whoever asked for the deployment.

required.description: Distinct approvals needed; 0 when the run needs none.

actor.description: Email of the actor (or its id if the user no longer exists).

next_before.description: Pass as `before` to fetch the next (older) page.

attempt.description: 1 for the first attempt; an infrastructure retry is the next one.

deployDecision.description:
`deployed`, or why the build did not deploy (`StaleSource`,
`BuildConfigChanged`, `NotAutomatic`, …).

challengeName.description: The TXT record that proves the claim, and its value.

method.description: `txt` or the provider kind that proved it.

fs_group.description: Group id owning the volumes, for images running as a non-root user.

oneOf.description:
Build the app from a Git repository instead (M3); its first build
deploys it.

image.description: The image to run; give this or `git`.

max_replicas.description: CPU autoscaling up to this many replicas when greater than `replicas`.

port.description: Port the process listens on; omit for workers and scheduled jobs.

schedule.description: Cron expression: the app runs as a scheduled job (no port).

environment.description: Narrows the tokens to one environment of `project`.

environments.description: GitHub environments allowed; empty for any.

events.description:
Workflow events allowed; `push`, `workflow_dispatch` and `release`
when empty.

tokenTtlSecs.description: Life of an exchanged token, 60–3600 seconds (default 900).

token.description: An API token that may edit the zones' DNS (write-only).

name.description: Short name, e.g. `prod` (the object is named `<project>-<name>`).

owner.description: Who answers for it: a person or a team.

project.description: Limit it to one project; every project when omitted.

environment.description: Restrict the token to one environment of `project`.

project.description: Restrict the token to one project.

role.description: Upper bound on what the token may do: `viewer`, `developer` or `admin`.

app.description: Silences only: one app of the environment.

token.description: The token itself. Shown exactly once; only its hash is stored.

comment.description: Why, for the record; at most 1024 characters.

planHash.description: The plan hash shown with the deployment (hex).

name.description: App name (also the in-cluster hostname of TCP services).

connection_keys.description: Reference it from other apps as `KEY=@<secret>/<key>`.

credentials_secret.description: Secret with the generated credentials, e.g. `db-credentials`.

DeploymentDto.description: A deployment run and where it stands.

approval_expires_at.description: When a run waiting for approval is cancelled (Unix milliseconds).

approvals_required.description: Distinct approvals the environment's policy requires before delivery.

generation.description: The target generation this run owns.

plan_hash.description: The hash approvers confirm (hex), when approvals are required.

warnings.description: What admission could not check, e.g. that the pods will be scheduled.

DeploymentSummary.description: A deployment run with how it went.

generation.description: The target generation (the app's revision) this run owns.

requested_by.description: Email of whoever asked for it.

timeline.description: Every phase it entered, oldest first.

reason.description: Why; kept with the record and audited.

completedAt.description: Set once the objects are orphaned.

export.description: The export frozen with the request (only when one app is read).

subject.description: What was checked (a host, a class, a port), when there are several.

findings.description: Conclusions, root causes first; nothing unobserved counts as fine.

graph.description:
Every layer from the build to the visitor, with what was observed
(M5.5).

status.description: The worst status of the checks; `unknown` is never `ok`.

addresses.description: Addresses the host currently resolves to.

reason.description: Why this cannot wait; kept on the run and in the audit log.

release.description:
The release to return to; the newest earlier release that ran
successfully when omitted.

failures.description: Deliveries given up in a row; the endpoint is disabled at 20.

secret.description: The signing secret: shown once, when the endpoint is made.

EnvVarDto.description: Environment variable: a plain `value` or a `secret` reference.

deletion_scheduled_at.description: When a soft-deleted environment will be purged.

name.description: Short name used in URLs, e.g. `prod`.

ExposureDto.description: How an app is reached through the gateway.

routed.description:
The gateway accepted the route and resolved its references; null
until a gateway controller answered.

hours.description: Hours added to the lifetime (at most 30 days from now in total).

keep.description: Keep the preview past its expiry until someone destroys it.

certificate_ready.description: For `auto` hosts with a certificate of their own: whether it is issued.

tls.description:
`auto` (certificate from the cluster issuer), `secret` (the app's own
certificate) or `none` (plain HTTP).

lastRun.description: The run the policy started last.

oneOf.description: The newest scan; `None` when the image was never scanned.

account.description: The GitHub user or organization the App is installed on.

temporary_password.description:
Temporary password for a newly created account. Shown once; it must be
replaced at the first login. `null` when the user already existed.

installationId.description: The id GitHub shows after the App is installed.

LogEnd.description:
A followed log stopped: one pod's (its container ended or could not be
read; a restarted container is followed again), or all of them (`pod` is
absent: the stream reached its limit).

LogLine.description: One line of a followed log.

must_change_password.description: Invited and has not replaced the temporary password yet.

available.description: False when there is nothing to show: never read as zero.

contact.description: How to reach them: an email, a chat channel, an on-call rotation.

PhaseStep.description: One step of a run's timeline.

at.description: When the run entered it, Unix milliseconds.

error.description: Why no logs could be read (e.g. the container is still starting).

revision.description: 0 when the environment has no policy of its own yet.

remainingSeconds.description: Seconds until it expires (0 once it has).

trusted.description: False for a fork's preview: it gets no secrets.

allowForks.description: Pull requests from forks get (untrusted) previews too.

sourceEnvironment.description: The environment whose Git-built apps previews copy.

to_environment.description: Target environment (short name) in the same project.

changes.description: Human-readable diff; values of environment variables are never shown.

created.description: The app did not exist in the target and was (or would be) created.

warnings.description: E.g. secrets referenced by the app that are missing in the target.

repository.description:
The repository to watch; the app's current image repository when
unset.

approvalTtlSecs.description: How long a deployment waits for approvals (300 s – 30 days).

approveRole.description: The weakest role that may approve: `admin` or `owner`.

deployRole.description: The weakest role that may deploy: `developer`, `admin` or `owner`.

oneOf.description: The vulnerability gate; the current one is kept when omitted.

password.description: A password or access token; write-only.

data.description: Key → UTF-8 value. Replaces the whole secret with a new revision.

rollout.description: Roll the new value out to the apps that reference the secret.

context.description: Build context inside the repository; the root when empty.

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile relative to the context; `Dockerfile` when unset.

imageRepository.description: Where builds push, without tag or digest.

installationId.description: A GitHub App installation linked to this organization.

environments.description: The environments whose apps the page lists.

registry.description: The registry as image references name it (`ghcr.io`, `docker.io`).

revoked.description:
The current revision is revoked: images from the registry are not
deployed until a new login is set.

actor.description: Email of whoever made the change.

current.description: The newest revision (what should be running).

RolloutDto.description: One app's rollout of a new secret value.

run.description: The rotation run; `None` when the app could not take one now.

process.description: Scheduled process to run (default: the first one).

databaseUpdatedAt.description: When the vulnerability database was built.

status.description:
`ok`, or `unavailable` when the scanner, its feed or the image was
not reachable (never "clean").

ScanGateDto.description: What vulnerability findings a deployment may carry.

maxAgeSecs.description: A scan older than this no longer counts (1 hour – 90 days).

requireScan.description: An image without a fresh successful scan counts as a finding.

severity.description: Findings at or above this severity count: `high` or `critical`.

keys.description: Key names only; values are never returned.

revision.description: The current revision of an encrypted secret.

revoked.description: The current revision is revoked: set a new value before deploying.

rollouts.description: The runs that roll a new value out, after a change.

SecretStorage.description: Where a secret's values are kept.

token.description: The setup token from the installer's link, when required.

needed.description: No admin account exists yet; the console shows `/setup`.

secure.description:
The admin may be created over this connection (HTTPS, this machine,
or allowed by configuration); otherwise `POST /setup` answers 403.

token_required.description: `POST /setup` must carry the token the installer printed.

head.description: The last head read from GitHub.

syncOperation.description: The sync this change or request queued, if any.

config.description:
The app configuration: the app spec without its image. Omitted, the
app's latest configuration is used.

expected_generation.description:
The target generation the caller last saw. A deploy never silently
replaces a newer one: a stale value is refused with `409`.

image.description:
Image by digest: `registry/repository@sha256:…`. Give either `image`
or `release`.

release.description: An existing release of this app: a rollback or a redeploy.

path.description: Where the page is served: `/status/<slug>` on the console's address.

provider.description: The DNS provider account to write through.

prefix.description: Non-secret prefix to recognise the token, e.g. `kbn_pat_0192f3a1`.

UpdateApp.description: Partial update; omitted fields are left unchanged, lists are replaced.

health_check_path.description: Empty string removes the health check.

volumes.description: Replaces the list. Removed volumes are unmounted, never deleted.

must_change_password.description:
The temporary password must be replaced (`POST /me/password`) before
anything else is allowed.

via.description: How the request was authenticated: `session` or `token`.

provider.description: Prove the claim with this DNS provider account instead of a TXT record.

VolumeDto.description: Persistent volume (kept when the app is deleted, unless requested).

size.description: Capacity such as `5Gi`. Can grow, never shrink.

app.description: Silences only: the app, when not the whole environment.
